variants.name: .45 ACP
variants.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .45 ACP.
Improve damage performance but makes the recoil harder to control. Lowered RPM.
Conversion kit by Vector Arms allows the UZI to use M3A1 magazines!

variants.name: .41 AE
variants.info:
Locks to Semi-Auto.
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .41 Action Express in a custom 20 round magazine. Perfect for seige missions.
Use this ammo to punch through cover, and land harder hits to take down the opposition.

variants.name: Plus P
variants.info:
Overpacked with powder, these rounds aim to make your bullets fly faster, penetrate surfaces better, and increase suppression.
Harder to control.

variants.name: .22 LR
variants.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .22 Long Rifle.
Stats similar to the ZIP22... But in full auto! Why would you do this?
Comes with a specially made 50 round Promag!

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
